- [x] **Log** (`/log`)
  - Read-only log views; export writes a file, and monitor uses a count snapshot.

  - [x] `clear` — `clear_logs` — not applicable on RouterOS 7 — RouterOS has no command to clear the in-memory log.
- [x] **Files** (`/file`)
  - File listing, removal and SFTP transfers are exposed; file creation and editing are not.
  - [x] `print` — `list_backups`, `backup_info`
  - [x] `remove` — `remove_file`

  - Documented in the configuration-management pages rather than a standalone CLI page.

- [x] **Configuration import** (`/import`)
  - [x] `import` — `import_configuration`

  - Not implemented. Copying files on the device is not exposed.
  - [ ] `copy` — not implemented

## Server-level tools

These tools do not map to a single RouterOS menu command.

- [x] `list_devices` — server — Inventory discovery; no RouterOS command.
- [x] `safe_mode_status` — interactive — Reads the persistent safe-mode shell state.
- [x] `enable_safe_mode` — interactive — Opens a persistent shell and sends Ctrl-X.
- [x] `commit_safe_mode` — interactive — Sends Ctrl-X again and closes the safe-mode shell.
- [x] `rollback_safe_mode` — interactive — Closes the shell to trigger RouterOS's automatic revert.
- [x] `generate_wireguard_client_config` — local — Formats a client configuration; does not contact the router.
- [x] `test_dns_query` — command — Runs :resolve on the device.
- [x] `create_basic_firewall_setup` — composite — Adds five /ip/firewall/filter rules in one call.
- [x] `check_wireless_support` — composite — Combines system resource, packages, interfaces and wireless detection.
- [x] `get_dns_cache_statistics` — composite — Combines /ip/dns print with /ip/dns/cache print count-only.
- [x] `get_log_statistics` — composite — Combines /log print count-only with per-topic and time-window counts.
- [x] `get_route_statistics` — composite — Combines several /ip/route print count-only queries.
- [x] `monitor_logs` — composite — Takes a count snapshot, waits, then reads the new entries.
- [x] `download_file` — sftp — Transfers raw bytes over the SSH SFTP subsystem.
- [x] `upload_file` — sftp — Transfers raw bytes over the SSH SFTP subsystem.
